Description: Verify that the CUSTOMER table exists before profiling.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CUSTOMER does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CUSTOMER;

Description: Detect null PK values in CUSTOMER.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CUSTOMER does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CUSTOMER','Customer_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Customer_ID does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CUSTOMER WHERE Customer_ID IS NULL;

Description: Find duplicate Customer_ID values.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CUSTOMER does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CUSTOMER','Customer_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Customer_ID does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 Customer_ID, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount FROM dbo.CUSTOMER WHERE Customer_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Customer_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DuplicateCount DESC, Customer_ID;

Description: Check duplicate emails and malformed email values.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CUSTOMER does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CUSTOMER','Email') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Email does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE BEGIN SELECT TOP 5 Email, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount FROM dbo.CUSTOMER WHERE Email IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Email HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DuplicateCount DESC; SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CUSTOMER WHERE Email IS NOT NULL AND Email NOT LIKE '%_@_%._%'; END

Description: Ensure customer name fields are populated if model requires them.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CUSTOMER does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CUSTOMER WHERE First_Name IS NULL OR Last_Name IS NULL;

Description: Verify ORDERS table exists.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDERS does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDERS;

Description: Every order should reference an existing customer.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Customer_ID') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.CUSTOMER','Customer_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Required column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 o.* FROM dbo.ORDERS o LEFT JOIN dbo.CUSTOMER c ON o.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID WHERE o.Customer_ID IS NOT NULL AND c.Customer_ID IS NULL;

Description: Ensure status values are restricted to approved set.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDERS does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Order_Status') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Order_Status does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDERS WHERE Order_Status IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(Order_Status) NOT IN ('NEW','PENDING','PAID','SHIPPED','CANCELLED','RETURNED');

TestScenario: Validate order date not in future
Description: Orders should not have future dates.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDERS does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Order_Date') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Order_Date does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDERS WHERE Order_Date > CAST(GETDATE() AS date);

Description: Order total must be zero or positive.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDERS does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Total_Amount') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Total_Amount does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDERS WHERE Total_Amount < 0;

Description: Verify ORDER_ITEM table exists.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDER_ITEM does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM;

Description: Each order item must belong to a valid order.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Order_ID') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Order_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Required column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 oi.* FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN dbo.ORDERS o ON oi.Order_ID = o.Order_ID WHERE oi.Order_ID IS NOT NULL AND o.Order_ID IS NULL;

Description: Each order item must reference an existing product.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Product_ID') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','Product_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Required column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 oi.* FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON oi.Product_ID = p.Product_ID WHERE oi.Product_ID IS NOT NULL AND p.Product_ID IS NULL;

Description: Quantity should be strictly positive.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDER_ITEM does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Quantity') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Quantity does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE Quantity IS NULL OR Quantity <= 0;

Description: Unit price must not be negative.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDER_ITEM does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Unit_Price') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Unit_Price does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE Unit_Price < 0;

Description: Prevent duplicate order lines for same product in same order unless business rules allow quantity aggregation.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table ORDER_ITEM does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Order_ID') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Product_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Required column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 Order_ID, Product_ID, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE Order_ID IS NOT NULL AND Product_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Order_ID, Product_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DuplicateCount DESC;

Description: Verify PRODUCT table exists.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PRODUCT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PRODUCT;

Description: Detect missing product keys.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PRODUCT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','Product_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Product_ID does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PRODUCT WHERE Product_ID IS NULL;

Description: Ensure each SKU is unique if UQ is intended.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PRODUCT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','SKU') IS NULL SELECT 'Column SKU does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 SKU, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount FROM dbo.PRODUCT WHERE SKU IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SKU HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DuplicateCount DESC;

Description: Every product should belong to a valid category.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.CATEGORY','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','Category_ID') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.CATEGORY','Category_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Required column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 p.* FROM dbo.PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN dbo.CATEGORY c ON p.Category_ID = c.Category_ID WHERE p.Category_ID IS NOT NULL AND c.Category_ID IS NULL;

Description: Product name should not be null if mandatory.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PRODUCT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','Product_Name') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Product_Name does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PRODUCT WHERE Product_Name IS NULL;

Description: Product price should be non-negative.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PRODUCT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','Price') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Price does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PRODUCT WHERE Price < 0;

Description: Verify CATEGORY table exists.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CATEGORY','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CATEGORY does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CATEGORY;

Description: Detect missing category keys.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CATEGORY','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CATEGORY does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CATEGORY','Category_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Category_ID does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CATEGORY WHERE Category_ID IS NULL;

Description: Category names should be unique if UQ applies.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CATEGORY','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CATEGORY does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CATEGORY','Category_Name') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Category_Name does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 Category_Name, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount FROM dbo.CATEGORY WHERE Category_Name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY Category_Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY DuplicateCount DESC;

Description: Category name should not be null if mandatory.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.CATEGORY','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table CATEGORY does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.CATEGORY','Category_Name') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Category_Name does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.CATEGORY WHERE Category_Name IS NULL;

Description: Verify PAYMENT table exists.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PAYMENT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PAYMENT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PAYMENT;

Description: Every payment must link to a valid order.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PAYMENT','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PAYMENT','Order_ID') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Order_ID') IS NULL SELECT 'Required column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 p.* FROM dbo.PAYMENT p LEFT JOIN dbo.ORDERS o ON p.Order_ID = o.Order_ID WHERE p.Order_ID IS NOT NULL AND o.Order_ID IS NULL;

Description: Payment method should be restricted to approved values.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PAYMENT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PAYMENT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PAYMENT','Payment_Method') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Payment_Method does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PAYMENT WHERE Payment_Method IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(Payment_Method) NOT IN ('CARD','CASH','UPI','BANK_TRANSFER','WALLET','CHEQUE');

Description: Payment amount must not be negative.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PAYMENT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PAYMENT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PAYMENT','Payment_Amount') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Payment_Amount does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PAYMENT WHERE Payment_Amount < 0;

TestScenario: Validate payment date not in future
Description: Payment dates should not be future-dated.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PAYMENT','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Table PAYMENT does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.PAYMENT','Payment_Date') IS NULL SELECT 'Column Payment_Date does not exist' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 * FROM dbo.PAYMENT WHERE Payment_Date > GETDATE();

Description: Validate each order belongs to exactly one customer; identify orphan orders.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.CUSTOMER','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 o.* FROM dbo.ORDERS o LEFT JOIN dbo.CUSTOMER c ON o.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID WHERE o.Customer_ID IS NOT NULL AND c.Customer_ID IS NULL;

Description: Each order item must map to one order; identify orphan order items.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 oi.* FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi LEFT JOIN dbo.ORDERS o ON oi.Order_ID = o.Order_ID WHERE oi.Order_ID IS NOT NULL AND o.Order_ID IS NULL;

Description: Every product should resolve to one valid category.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.CATEGORY','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 p.* FROM dbo.PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN dbo.CATEGORY c ON p.Category_ID = c.Category_ID WHERE p.Category_ID IS NOT NULL AND c.Category_ID IS NULL;

Description: Validate every payment belongs to a valid order.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PAYMENT','U') IS NULL OR OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT TOP 5 p.* FROM dbo.PAYMENT p LEFT JOIN dbo.ORDERS o ON p.Order_ID = o.Order_ID WHERE p.Order_ID IS NOT NULL AND o.Order_ID IS NULL;

Description: Check min/max/avg and identify outliers.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDERS','U') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDERS','Total_Amount') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table/column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT MIN(Total_Amount) AS MinAmount, MAX(Total_Amount) AS MaxAmount, AVG(CAST(Total_Amount AS decimal(18,2))) AS AvgAmount, STDEV(CAST(Total_Amount AS decimal(18,2))) AS StdDevAmount FROM dbo.ORDERS;

Description: Check min/max/avg price to identify anomalies.
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.PRODUCT','U') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.PRODUCT','Price') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table/column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT MIN(Price) AS MinPrice, MAX(Price) AS MaxPrice, AVG(CAST(Price AS decimal(18,2))) AS AvgPrice, STDEV(CAST(Price AS decimal(18,2))) AS StdDevPrice FROM dbo.PRODUCT;

Description: Detect extreme values or skew in quantities.
ExpectedResult: Quantities should be mostly within business range
ValidationQuery: IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','U') IS NULL OR COL_LENGTH('dbo.ORDER_ITEM','Quantity') IS NULL SELECT 'Required table/column missing' AS Issue; ELSE SELECT MIN(Quantity) AS MinQty, MAX(Quantity) AS MaxQty, AVG(CAST(Quantity AS decimal(18,2))) AS AvgQty, STDEV(CAST(Quantity AS decimal(18,2))) AS StdDevQty FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM;
